confirmedFindings.title: Synchronous blocking HTTP call inside GenServer handle_call
confirmedFindings.body: Performing a synchronous HTTP POST inside handle_call blocks the GenServer message queue, leading to caller timeouts under load.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Dispatch metric forwarding asynchronously with Task.Supervisor.start_child/2 or cast to a dedicated worker pool.
